entries.purpose: Approved vendors with payment terms, tax identifiers, remittance details, duplicate-detection aliases, and AP owner.
Open and recently closed purchase orders with line items, tolerances, approvers, cost centers, receipt status, and remaining balances.
Receipt evidence keyed by PO, SKU, quantity, accepted date, receiver, and unresolved discrepancy notes.

Prior approval decisions, approver conditions, rejected overrides, and audit evidence used to shorten later review cycles.
